conviction_note: Nothing found that decides the print: the revenue bar (~$188.8m) sits on the guide's own trajectory, the one Bausch + Lomb read-through is a mild positive proxy, and the new negatives (Alkeus opex reset, lock-up expiries, a ~$568m IPR&D charge) are disclosed and partly flagged in previews, offset by a crowded short (8.3 days to cover); the findings sum to +0.2 and the scaled number is +0.18 at p_up 51 on a 9% absolute move, so the two measurements agree that this is close to a non-result.

The EPS consensus of -$1.43 does NOT appear to include the ~$568m acquired IPR&D charge disclosed in the 8-K/A pro forma, so the GAAP EPS bar is not comparable.

findings.finding: The Alkeus acquisition (closed 2026-09-04) is accounted as initial consolidation of a VIE with acquired IPR&D of $564.8m plus $3.0m inventory, $567.8m in total, expensed as acquired IPR&D (8-K/A pro forma, 2026-10-13); booked in Q3 this puts GAAP EPS near -$12 to -$13 on ~47m shares against a -$1.43 consensus that by its own description covers deal costs but not this charge, so headline feeds will print a giant 'miss'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior Tarsus print carried an IPR&D charge of this size; the name has traded on XDEMVY revenue and guidance (Q2 2026 guide raise +6.59%, Q1 2026 reaffirm -1.24%). Non-cash, disclosed, no path to the XDEMVY guide.
findings.why_not_priced: The charge is public in the pro forma, so the economic content is priced; what may not be is the mechanical headline (EPS -$12 vs -$1.43) hitting algorithmic readers after hours. If the street had folded it in, the published consensus would sit near -$12, not -$1.43.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers preview (https://finviz.com/news/412635/tarsus-must-show-xtemvi-can-outrun-its-pricier-retina-ambitions-in-q3) says R&D guidance $190-210m does not cover the Alkeus deal and EPS consensus reflects deal costs; consistent but different source. Deal terms from the 8-K of 2026-09-10 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1819790/000181979026000066/tars-20260904.htm).

findings.finding: The FY guide arithmetic leaves room only for a raise: with H1 at $319.3m and Q3 consensus at $188.8m, the $685-705m range implies Q4 of $177-197m, i.e. flat-to-down from Q3 at the low end, in a quarter management described on the Q2 call as seasonally strongest; a Q3 at or above consensus therefore makes a raise or a top-end firming likely on this call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide raised with Q2 (2026-08-06, bmo): +6.59%. Guide initiated with Q4 2025 (2026-02-23): +7.79%. Guide reaffirmed with Q1 (2026-05-06): -1.24%. Q3 2025 print (2025-11-04): -4.62% despite +147% y/y growth.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the Earnings Whispers preview itself calls the floor conservative, and the stock is up ~29% since the Q2 print, so a modest raise is the expectation. What is not priced is the size: a raise to, say, $700-720m versus a top-end-only nudge; if a large raise were priced the stock would sit near its $91.53 post-earnings high rather than 18% below its 52w high.
findings.independence: Q2 call summary on Q4 seasonality (https://www.stocktaper.com/earningsCallSummary/TARS/2026/Q2, via search snippet; page returned 429) and the Earnings Whispers preview (https://finviz.com/news/412635/tarsus-must-show-xtemvi-can-outrun-its-pricier-retina-ambitions-in-q3), same arithmetic. Proxy: no IQVIA script series reached.

findings.finding: Bausch + Lomb's Q3 2026 release (2026-10-28, after Tarsus last spoke) shows MIEBO, a branded eye-care Rx written by the same optometry/ophthalmology prescriber base, at $119m, +42% y/y and +31% q/q from $91m (+44% y/y in Q2), so the eye-care branded-Rx channel did not slow in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of Tarsus trading on a peer read-through found; its last four XDEMVY revenue prints moved -4.62, +7.79, -1.24, +6.59.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a peer's number, not Tarsus's, and Q3 consensus for XDEMVY ($188.8m) predates nothing about it; if the market had read it through, Tarsus's 5-day run-up (+5.26%) would be the visible trace, and that may already be it. MIEBO's Q3 sequential jump was similar in 2025 (implied ~$84m vs ~$63m), so this is stable growth, not acceleration.
findings.independence: Proxy only; no Tarsus-specific script data (IQVIA/Symphony) was reachable. finsee.ai review (https://finsee.ai/earnings/blco/2026/q3/en/) repeats the same figure from the same release.

findings.finding: Alkeus brings a new cost base the 2026 R&D guide ($190-210m) excludes: Alkeus ran a $49.8m net loss in FY2025 and the pro forma notes ~$22.5m of retention and option-acceleration compensation, and the company plans 50-75 retina sales reps for a Stargardt readout not expected until 2H 2029; an updated opex guide with Alkeus is due on this call and the 2027 profitability target may slip.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior opex-guide reset on this name in the baseline window; the Q3 2025 print (-4.62%) is the only one in the set that fell on a growth quarter, cause not established here.
findings.why_not_priced: The direction is flagged in the preview, so the existence of higher opex is priced; the magnitude is not, because no number for 2027 opex including Alkeus and a retina field force has been published. If it were priced the EPS consensus for 2027 would visibly have moved; no source shows that.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers preview (https://finviz.com/news/412635/tarsus-must-show-xtemvi-can-outrun-its-pricier-retina-ambitions-in-q3) on R&D guide scope, 50-75 retina reps and 2H 2029 readout; shares the pro forma document with finding 1 for the Alkeus loss figures, but finding 1 is the one-off charge and this one is the recurring cost, so they are separate money.

findings.finding: Supply unlocks inside the window: the 90-day company/officer/director lock-up from the 2026-08-05 PIPE purchase agreement runs to about 2026-11-03, and 2,630,416 Alkeus merger shares (registered for resale 2026-10-13, deemed value $83.21) leave their two-month lock-up around 2026-11-04, though 1,994,414 of them stay under volume limits for three more months; separately 2,232,144 PIPE shares bought at ~$56 ($125m) are registered for resale and sit ~33% in profit at $74.48.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior lock-up expiry on this name in the baseline window.
findings.why_not_priced: Dates are derived from the prospectus terms (two months after closing, 90 days after the purchase agreement), not stated as calendar dates, and are not in previews; only ~0.9m Alkeus shares are free of both lock-up and volume limits, about one day of the 0.88m average volume, so the effect is small. If it were priced, borrow and short interest would be rising into the date; short interest was rising modestly into September.
findings.independence: PIPE resale S-3ASR (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1819790/000119312526420490/d152392ds3asr.htm), a different filing, same date. The Alkeus holders' deemed price of $83.21 is above spot, which reduces their incentive to sell at the unlock.

findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is the market's own state, not information; it matters only conditional on the print. Its weight here is that it makes the guidance finding's upside tail fatter than its downside.

baseline_tension: No skew is available; the ~29% run-up since Q2 and a 5-day +5.26% raise the bar for a guide raise, while the crowded short (8.3 days) cuts the other way, so the evidence neither agrees nor fights a directional market statement and sits close to balanced.
lessons_applied: Lesson 7 (crowded short shrinks negatives, 8.29 days to cover): Alkeus opex reset -1.0 -> -0.8, lock-up supply -0.5 -> -0.4, insider selling -0.2 -> -0.1.
Lesson 2 (one-off below the guide sized as a fraction): IPR&D charge -0.5 -> -0.3, it is non-cash, disclosed in the pro forma and has no path to the XDEMVY guide.
Lesson 6 (verify the bar): two estimate sources roughly agree ($188.8m, $187.8m snippet) plus the company guide, so no cap applied; EPS bar flagged as non-comparable because of the IPR&D charge.
Lesson 1 and 5 left standing: guidance finding kept at +1.0 given the name's mixed reaction to beats; MIEBO read-through kept small as a proxy. p_up moved from 50 to 51 as the net of the revisions.
